title: PLSsemLab: A jamovi Module for Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling

creators.name: Chacón Chacón, Arquímedes De León
creators.affiliation: Universidad Católica Andrés Bello (UCAB), Caracas, Venezuela

description: An open-source jamovi module that brings partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to jamovi with the cSEM R package: measurement and structural model evaluation with bootstrap inference (reliability, AVE, HTMT, VIF, f², effects), a bootstrap test of overall model fit, higher-order constructs and interactions, prediction (PLSpredict, CVPAT), mediation, importance-performance map analysis and multigroup comparison with MICOM, pairing every result with evidence-based methodological guidance, interpretation and educational support in English and Spanish.
